items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith (and Dontayvion Wicks) for Monday Night Football vs Cowboys.
items.why: Injury report; confirmed via beat and Schefter.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in PHI passing game for MNF. Saquon expected; Goedert/AJB elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining WRs/TE; possible more Saquon involvement.

items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; third straight miss. Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; ruled out by team.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and rush threat downgraded. Fade Lamar-dependent pieces or adjust DFS.
items.opportunity: Huntley volume; possible increased checkdowns to Andrews/Flowers/Likely.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) remains QUESTIONABLE/GTD for Sunday vs Raiders after limited/no practice; McVay/Rapoport call minor but not precautionary. Adams already OUT.
items.why: Calf issue Thursday practice; DNP Friday; listed Q.
items.implication: Nuclear upside if active (Adams out); massive downgrade and TE/WR funnel if OUT. Late window monitor.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Higbee lead TE, other Rams WRs/TEs spike; Stafford volatility.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) QUESTIONABLE/GTD vs Dolphins after limited practices; missed prior three games. Allen in line for big role if OUT.
items.implication: Committee or limited if plays; Allen locked RB1/2 upside in great matchup if Hall inactive.
items.opportunity: Braelon Allen carries/targets spike on OUT; Hall snap share key if active.

items.text: 49ers WR Christian Kirk activated and expected to play Sunday; amid heavy WR injuries (Evans/Deebo OUT).
items.implication: Helps thin SF WR room; CMC potential slot usage per Levitan/Tafur notes.
items.opportunity: Kirk targets; Kittle funnel; CMC routes up.

items.text: Vikings activated RB Jordan Mason off IR; expected to play Sunday vs Colts.
items.implication: Committee or lead potential with Aaron Jones; monitor split.
items.opportunity: Mason carries/snaps; Jones share may dip.

items.text: Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play Monday vs Dallas; DeVonta Smith out.
items.why: Injury report and Rapoport confirmation after return to practice.
items.implication: Strong RB play vs good matchup; start if active. Pair with elevated pass catchers due to WR outs.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full workload possible; Dallas soft vs RBs.

items.text: Texans activated WR Tank Dell; set for season debut Sunday (first action in ~2 years).
items.implication: Instant WR depth/target competition in HOU; monitor routes vs Collins etc. Debut rust possible.
items.opportunity: Immediate route share possible; impacts Nico/others slightly.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt list; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.why: Official activation; Schefter/Rapoport report expected to play.
items.implication: Returns to lead back role post-layoff. Monitor snap share vs rust.
items.opportunity: Primary carries/goal-line; handcuff Wilson fades if full workload.

items.text: Jonah Coleman activated/expected for Broncos; Berry says he will be the Broncos RB you wish you had by year end—roster in 100% of leagues. Had 13 touches/TD before injury.
items.why: Designated return/activated; prior production + Dobbins/Harvey inefficiency.
items.implication: Immediate handcuff/lead candidate; high waiver priority.
items.opportunity: Touches in DEN backfield; long-term stash upside.

items.text: Levitan flags Lamar (ankle), Puka (calf), Breece (quad) statuses as crucial for Sunday DFS main slate. Sneaky important OUTs: Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka, Jahwar Jordan.
items.why: Direct impact on slate construction and implied ownership/opps.
items.implication: Have plans for all three Qs; pivot to beneficiaries on OUTs (e.g. Bijan, IND TE alts, TB WRs).
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups/handcuffs on confirmed OUTs.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); Bijan Robinson expected full bell-cow workload vs SF.
items.why: Hamstring; ETR OUT list and reports.
items.implication: Bijan clear RB1 with expanded carries/snaps/red zone vs soft-ish SF run D in slow-paced game.
items.opportunity: Bijan snap share/carries/goal-line near 100% of backfield.

items.text: Multiple star WRs OUT: Davante Adams, Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Rashee Rice, Emeka Egbuka per ETR Sunday dump. Impacts LAR/SF/KC/TB offenses heavily.
items.implication: Puka (if active) or alts massive in LAR; SF to Kittle/CMC/Kirk; KC to Worthy/others; TB to Godwin/Irving etc.
items.opportunity: Clear path for remaining pass catchers and checkdowns.

items.text: ETR IN list includes Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison, TJ Hockenson, Josh Jacobs, Rashod Bateman among others expected/active.
items.why: ETR early Sunday compilation matching activations.
items.implication: Full or expanded roles confirmed for these; reverse any prior fade.
items.opportunity: Judkins CLE backfield; Addison MIN targets with Jefferson.

items.text: Levitan tempted by CMC lining up more in slot amid 49ers dire WR injuries (Evans/Deebo OUT, Kirk returning); rarely buys RB-as-WR but SF situation + Black makes it plausible. Kittle funnel likely.
items.why: CMC quote + smile on possible slot; thin WR room.
items.implication: CMC receiving upside spike; Kittle as primary funnel.

items.text: Berry loves A.J. Brown (@ CHI, WR10) for usage/matchup and Tucker Kraft (@ DET, TE6) vs Lions TE-friendly D (9 TE TDs allowed).
items.why: Bears good for yardage; Lions gift to opposing pass catchers/TEs.
items.implication: Strong start signals; Kraft especially in smash spot.

items.text: Berry loves Jaylen Warren (@ NO), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB), Bucky Irving (@ CAR) for big workloads in friendly matchups. Saquon if active (RB15).
items.why: Volume + defenses carved by RBs; Saquon efficiency + Dallas matchup.

items.text: Berry hates Josh Jacobs (@ DET, post-layoff workload questions), Rome Odunze (vs NE/Gonzalez shadow), Josh Downs, Travis Kelce (tough matchups/roles).
items.why: Layoff rust for Jacobs; shadow/matchup for Odunze; target share/low scoring for Downs; tough D for Kelce.
items.implication: Fade or sit in tight lineups despite Jacobs activation.
items.conflict: Jacobs expected to play but Berry cautious on volume.
